name: sentaurus-web-agent
description: Browser dashboard/chat for a Sentaurus TCAD agent bridge.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sentaurus-agent/server" "npm run dev -w @sentaurus-agent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentaurus-agent/shared && npm run build -w @sentaurus-agent/server && npm run build -w @sentaurus-agent/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sentaurus-agent/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sentaurus-agent/server && npm run typecheck -w @sentaurus-agent/web && npm run typecheck -w @sentaurus-agent/shared
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build
